newsitem.title: UK: UK's Wescol wins 16.5 mln stg contract.
newsitem.headline: UK's Wescol wins 16.5 mln stg contract.

text.p: British engineering company Wescol Group Plc said on Monday it had been awarded a 16.5 million stg contract to partially develop a shopping centre near Scotland's Glasgow's Airport.

Wescol said the contract -- to supply and erect structural steelworks, metal deck flooring and concrete staircases -- has been awarded to its joint venture with Glosford Metal Construction, a firm of Glosford Holdings which it is in the process of taking over.
Wescol said the contract included supply of over 13,000 tonnes of steel over a 20-week period with 1,000 tonnes per week being supplied at the peak. The project is expected to start in October, 1997.
The shopping centre is being developed by Capital Shopping Centres Plc.
